newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: EU says WTO infotech talks at critical stage.
newsitem.headline: EU says WTO infotech talks at critical stage.

text.p: Talks among World Trade Organisation ministers to liberalise trade in information technology are at a critical stage, European Trade Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan said on Monday.
"I very much hope that we will will agree... but I can't say that we've got it yet," Brittan told a news conference.
He earlier held what he described as "amicable" talks on the issue with acting U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky and the two were due to meet again after dinner.
Brittan said issues outstanding included the range of products to be covered by an agreement, the countries that would participate and a timetable for removing tariffs.
He said the European Union would be ready to implement a deal next year but would be willing to wait until 2000 if other countries insisted.
"We're at a critical stage of the negotiations and I don't think it's helpful to highlight the differences," Brittan said.
